phase: Phase 4b: The live runs and the first track A results (by Sun 2026-11-22)
summary: Pass under the PM round cap. No real-key leak was found. The three gate violation arrays are empty. The live path makes no seed call, no auth call, and no DELETE. Two low findings and one caller-side gap are nonblocking.
nonblocking_findings: F-B1 [Low] review-b: The L5 send-timeout test is timing sensitive. One full-file run gave 129 pass and 1 fail. The case expected 'the message send timed out' and got 'the model answer did not complete'. The same case passed alone. A second full run gave 130 pass and 0 fail. A 1-second call budget decides between a curl timeout and the deadline path under load. This is test reliability, not a security gap. Route to the orchestrator.

F-B2 [Major, nonblocking] review-b: The night driver does not export BENCH_SERVER_BASE. probe-4.10.sh:15 exports it. night-4.11.sh exports only BENCH_QUOTA_BASE. A pilot night run will refuse before any model call. This is Review A F15 on the caller side, outside the audited HEAD. No key leak. Route to the orchestrator before the 2026-11-22 night run.

F-B3 [Low] review-b: The live LIVE_KEY_SHAPE scan omits PEM private key blocks. It covers sk-, xox*, ghp_, github_pat_, and AKIA. The audit key scan also matches '[private-key header pattern]-----'. No provider in this repo uses a PEM key. A model answer with a PEM key would be stored unscanned. Optional hardening for Green.

The runners use three API endpoints only: /api/session, /api/session/$session/prompt, and /api/session/$session/message. No DELETE and no other-session operation appears in either runner. L7 covers this.
Every curl target is $LIVE_BASE. No echo or printf of the answer text or the staging file appears. git status --short docs/ is empty.
review-run.sh:1380-1401, 1525-1532, and 1809-1829 scan stored text and error lines for LIVE_KEY_SHAPE before the store. L8 covers this.
Route parity: the sha256 of live_remaining, live_curl, live_session_create, live_synthesize, live_wait_answer, error_line_of, error_event_text, and scan_output matched between the two runners.

Key scan: git log -p 7d7d218..HEAD grep for sk-, AKIA, ghp_, and PEM returned three hits. All are synthetic test constants in review-run.test.ts:94, adversarial-p4-runner.test.ts:44 and :46, judge-run.test.ts:92, adversarial-p4b.test.ts:125, and adversarial-p4c.test.ts:83. No real key appeared in production code or a committed data file.

The first full review-run gave 129 pass and 1 fail in the L5 timing case. The case passed alone in 2.01 seconds and passed on the second full run in 226.65 seconds. This is a timing flake.
bash -n passed on both runners. The leak-check script needs a private fixture and a temp git repo; Green recorded exit 0 with that setup in green-4.16.txt:52. I did not rebuild that fixture.

measure/tracks.md:34 lists model_guide as pending and makes no resolved security claim. Rubric A2 and A6 do not apply to this row.

I made no edit outside measure/runs/model_guide/. I ran no opencode or openchamber CLI, no live GET to port 38307, no POST, no DELETE, no commit, and no push. I read no session text, no credential store, and no real key.
